Method Each curve begins within the selected start month and accumulates daily rainfall for the following 12 months. Curves with no reading during that first month are excluded. Estate-level daily rainfall is averaged across measurement tools; the overall view averages across visible estates before accumulating.

No plantations match the selected filters.
Method Historical weekly rainfall uses complete Monday–Sunday weeks. SAP observations are used through each plantation’s latest available date. Missing days after that date and before today are filled with Open-Meteo recent archived model rainfall and shown as a solid yellow line. The next 14 days use the latest Open-Meteo forecast and are shown as a dashed yellow line. Boundary weeks may contain fewer than seven external days.
